dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Lauma</color> seems to have heard something...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Strange. I'm sure I just heard something.
(Ah, guests! Come, come! Spin the wheel, then stop the wheel, and then there'll be good food!)
(Huh? Why aren't you spinning the wheel? Go on, spin it. Good food awaits!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: That sounds... like a little puppy? Spin the wheel for good food... What does that mean?
(Ho there, guests! You can speak to me! Well, please spin the wheel, then, or I shan't have anything delicious to eat!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Are you hungry, then? I've brought some biscuits. Here, have one.
(Hmm? You're not spinning the wheel, but you want to give me food... Hmm, sure. I'll grab some first. Why not?)

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Thank you, guest. Pavlov's the name, and thanks for the biscuit. It was dee-licious! Still, you didn't spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: You're quite welcome... But if I might ask, what do you mean by "spinning the wheel"?

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (If the wheel is spun, then stopped, good food will drop down. That's how it always is.)

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Won't you spin the wheel, dear guest? Everyone feels happy after spinning it.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I suppose I shan't. It seems... you are living well here?

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Of course, of course! People play with me, the wheel plays with me, and there's good food.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Then that is well. Say hello to your owner for me. I'll be off now.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Ohh... See you, guest! Come again!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hmm? Is that some <color=#FFCC33FF>small animal</color> I hear...?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (If there was someone present who could understand animal speech, perhaps they'd be able to pinpoint the source of this sound...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Columbina</color> seems to have heard something...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Strange... I think I hear something.
(Ah, guests! Come, come! Spin the wheel, then stop the wheel, and then there'll be good food!)
(Huh? Why aren't you spinning the wheel? Go on, spin it. Good food awaits!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: A little dog...? Are you asking me to spin your wheel for you?
(Ho there, guests! You can speak to me! Well, please spin the wheel, then, or I shan't have anything delicious to eat!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Are you hungry? I just bought some snacks. Here, have a bit.
(Hmm? You're not spinning the wheel, but you want to give me food... Hmm, sure. I'll grab some first. Why not?)

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Thank you, guest. Pavlov's the name, and thanks for the food! It was dee-licious! Still, you didn't spin the wheel.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: These snacks are rather good. But... this wheel you mentioned... what exactly does it do?

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (If the wheel is spun, then stopped, good food will drop down. That's how it always is.)

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Won't you spin the wheel, dear guest? Everyone feels happy after spinning it.)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If I spin the wheel... will you be happy?

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Of course, of course! People play with me, the wheel plays with me, and there's good food... the food is the best part!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I see... Yes, good food is important. Here, take the rest of these as well.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I need to go buy more. See you, Pavlov.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlov
dialogues.text: (Mmm... yummy, yummy! Goodbye, guest! Come again!)
